decision: The upstream change alters modern MDC M2 system-token color variants. Owned legacy select themes use historical foreground and primary, accent and warn palette text entries with legacy arrow selectors; the upstream system-token emitter is not an owned legacy target. The decision preserves the historical M2 source contract and asserts no forced-colors or native M3 execution.
